products.note: Meeting analytics AI; engagement scoring; wellness insights; behavioral data privacy

profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as an AI copilot that transforms meetings, emails, and messages into summaries, insights, and instant answers across devices. Its site positions the product as platform-agnostic, connecting across a range of tools including meetings, messages, emails, CRM systems, and documents to deliver what it calls unified insights.

The company's primary product, Read AI, is tracked in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category. It offers real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across content types. The site also notes meeting analytics, engagement scoring, wellness insights, and behavioral data privacy as features associated with the product.

The held facts show no litigation on record. Read AI has a presence in the MCP registry indirectly through the Leaf reading assistant server, which lists it as an integration target for tracking books and logging reading sessions, though that server is a third-party tool rather than a Read company product.
